# trit

> Packed ternary weights (P2 4 trits/byte, P3 1.6 bits/weight, L5 compute on storage) with integer-only kernels that are bit-identical on scalar, AVX2, AVX-512 and NEON, in C++ and Rust.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/trit && cd trit && g++ -O3 -march=native -fopenmp -std=c++17 -Icpp tests/trit_kernel_test.cpp -o /tmp/trit_kernel_test && /tmp/trit_kernel_test | tail -1` (expect: "pass": true).
Status: pre-alpha, under development — read STATUS.md before relying on a number.
Licence: Apache-2.0 (code) + CC BY 4.0 (documents).
